summary: Frontend testing of 6 new features: audio cleanup bug fix, QLD time display, Rose Temple, Elemental Temples, Masculine Temple, Partner Yoga, Yoga Library Accessible filter, and MainMenu Sacred Temples section. All features verified working correctly.

issues: QLD time clock is ONLY visible in top nav bar for non-authenticated users (hidden when user is logged in, replaced by 'Dashboard' button). For logged-in users, QLD time is only visible inside the 'Explore Practices' menu overlay header. Consider showing it for logged-in users too if that's the intent.

critical_code_review_comments: Audio cleanup Breathwork.jsx (lines 46-68): Properly closes AudioContext with .close() on unmount - CORRECT
Audio cleanup Meditations.jsx (lines 68-80): Properly pauses, clears src, and nulls audioRef on unmount - CORRECT

QLD time: Only shows in top nav bar when user is NOT logged in (hidden md:flex condition inside !user block). Logged-in users only see it in the menu overlay. Minor UX consideration if always-visible time was intended for all users.
test_credentials: No login required - all pages are public
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 new features tested and verified passing: audio cleanup code verified by code review + observation of 'Playing 432 Hz tone' console log and subsequent navigation; QLD time shows in top nav (non-logged-in users) and always in menu overlay; Rose Temple has 5 teaching cards with modal; Elemental Temples has 5 elements with 5 section tabs each; Masculine Temple has 5 archetype cards with modal; Partner Yoga has 8 poses with difficulty filter (6 beginner); Yoga Library has Accessible/mobility filter (50 beginner from 78 total) + Partner Yoga banner; Main Menu has Sacred Temples section with 3 cards. Previous backend test report (iteration_24.json) confirmed 100% backend pass rate.
